(function_declaration
  body: (statement_block
    (lexical_declaration
      (variable_declarator
        value: (member_expression
          object: (identifier) @first_obj
          property: (property_identifier) @first_prop)))
    (expression_statement
      (call_expression
        function: (member_expression
          object: (identifier) @keys_obj
          property: (property_identifier) @keys_prop)
        arguments: (arguments
          (identifier) @keys_arg)))
    (lexical_declaration
      (variable_declarator
        value: (member_expression
          object: (identifier) @second_obj
          property: (property_identifier) @metadata)))
  )
  (#eq? @first_obj @keys_arg)
  (#eq? @keys_arg @second_obj)
  (#eq? @keys_prop "keys")
  (#match? @metadata "^(name|length|prototype)$")
)
